newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siu-fung appoints chairman as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Siu-fung appoints chairman as CEO.

text.p: Siu-fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd on Wednesday it had appointed its chairman Siegfried Lee as chief executive officer, and Benjamin Li as managing director of the company and its subsidiaries.
The company said Du Ying Tzeyong had resigned as chief executive officer and managing director effective April 25.

The ceramics and machinery maker said it was still at a relatively preliminary stage in its negotiations with potential investors regarding a possible investment in the company and/or a disposal of assets of the group.
New World Development Co Ltd has said it proposed to take a majority stake in Siu-fung.

Siu-fung said last November it had serious cashflow problems and was in discussions with banks to identify immediate funding requirements and alternatives for restructuring its debt, and was considering sale of assets.
